## User storyw
As a registered user i want to be able to sign in to an account to access PawLink.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ The user must have an account to begin with. ] 
- [ The user must use an email and password that was created with the account] 
- [ The user must enter the correct email and password to sign in.] 
log out
- [ The user must be signed in.]
- [ The user must be able to click on a button that triggers them to be signout and announce they have been signed out and returns them back to the splash page like an unregistred user sees.]

## Notes
users should be able to use email as a sign in and as a notifcation. I think we take everything before the @ and make that their username.

## User story
As a Registered User, I want i want to be able to create a profile for my dog, so that i can find potentioal matches to schedule park meetups with

## Acceptance criteria
- [ User must have an account to even have this as an option] 
- [ User must be signed in to be able to access the screen] 
- [ User must have a dog to be able to enter this information.] 


## Notes
What information will we want to use
Dog's information
Name
Age
Sex
Size
Location
Temperment
Energy level



---
name: View potential matches, ranked by compatibility score
about: Ability to get matches and how the ranking system works
title: As a Registered User, I want to be able to find matches for my dog and rank profiles based on their dog
type: Feature
---

## User story
As a Registered User, I want to be able to find matches for my dog and rank profiles based on their dog so that i can create or find park meetups

## Acceptance criteria
- [ Able to swipe or scroll through possible matches] 
- [ Matches are created based on the qualifications and most likley have a weighted system] 
- [ Ranking peopls dogs and leaving a comment on why they ranked them so future users understand how that dog is] 

## Notes
Swiping like dating app, scrolling like buying a car?
Which order do we want the catergories to be weighted strongest to weakest to find better matches.
I think we want to use a 5 star system for the ranking.

## User story
As a Registered User, I want to be able to request and accept park meet ups so that i can now meet with new people. 

## Acceptance criteria
- [ Click on a screen that says accept or deny] 
- [ Click on a button that has a park you can set the place and time and what dogs you might want] 
- [ Click on people nearby or suggested dogs that would best fit the park and type of dog you are looking for] 

## Notes
Do we want to have it send an "email" to all nearby people within a 50 mile radius or like a post kinda like twitter that notifies people enarby that were not "specifically" invited to possibly join the meetup
